guidance.bestFor: A landscape 16:9 box, the shape of video players and modern slide decks, in a column up to 28rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: A strip wider than standard video for a cinematic page header

guidance.bestFor: The 4:3 shape of phone camera photos and classic TV footage, in a landscape box up to 28rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: Photos from most DSLR and 35mm film cameras, which come out at 3:2

guidance.bestFor: An equal sided box for product shots, album covers and grid tiles, kept to 20rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: A small round user photo with an initials fallback

guidance.bestFor: An extra wide 21:9 strip for cinematic banners and page headers, at most 28rem across

whenNotToUse.when: Ordinary widescreen video and thumbnails at the usual TV shape

guidance.bestFor: A tall 9:16 box, the shape of stories and short full screen vertical video, at most 20rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: A portrait post that should take less height in a scrolling feed

guidance.bestFor: The 3:2 shape of most DSLR and 35mm film photos, for blog and article images up to 28rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: Most phone camera photos, which come out at 4:3 by default

guidance.bestFor: A slightly tall 4:5 box sized for portrait posts in a social feed, kept to 20rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: Full screen vertical video and story posts

guidance.bestFor: The 16:10 shape of many laptop and monitor displays, for app screenshots and device mockups up to 28rem wide

whenNotToUse.when: Video made for the 16:9 shape of TVs and players
